slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: items
slots.about: the things: id, title, sub (a short line such as a part), done_min, total_min, last_at (the date last opened), plays (how popular), dropped (false; true once taken out of the resume card)

slots.name: resume_title
slots.about: the section title over the resume card

slots.name: popular_title
slots.about: the section title over the list

slots.name: left_word
slots.about: after the minutes still to go

slots.name: playing_word
slots.about: on the card while it plays

slots.name: resume_word
slots.about: spoken before the title on the card

slots.name: more_label
slots.about: spoken on the card's more button

slots.name: drop_word
slots.about: the menu action that takes the item out of the resume card

slots.name: finish_word
slots.about: the menu action that marks the item finished

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: what shows when there is nothing in the list

empty.shows: empty; with nothing half done the resume section is left out and the list moves up

fallback.shows: no resume card: its title hides too

attention.shows: the card's line says playing_word in accent and its icon shows pause; a playing tile fills

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, shrink and swap

notes: The card is the half-done item opened last (ties to the lower id). Dropping or finishing it promotes the next half-done one; the list below never repeats the card's item.
